What is Smartcat?

End-to-end AI translation and localisation platform combining machine translation, a CAT editor, translation memory, an integrated marketplace of 500,000+ human linguists, and automated payments to those linguists in one system.

Best for

Running a full localisation operation - MT plus human review plus vendor payment - in one platform.

Main features

  • AI translation with automatic engine selection per language pair
  • full CAT editor with translation memory and termbases
  • built-in linguist marketplace with vetted freelancers
  • automated multi-currency payment and compliance for contractors
  • AI Video dubbing and subtitling
  • AI Design for translating layouts
  • workflow automation and connectors
  • enterprise SSO and audit.

Practical use cases

  • Translating a product documentation set into 20 languages with human post-editing
  • managing and paying a freelance linguist pool
  • localising video with dubbing and subtitles
  • continuous website and app localisation.

Who is it for?

  • Localisation managers, enterprise content teams, translation agencies, e-learning and marketing teams running continuous multilingual content.

Pricing, free access & limits

Seat-based subscription plus usage (words/pages); marketplace is commission-based

Plans described in the source

Free/Starter tier with limited words. Business tiers typically start around $99-249/mo per workspace with word-volume allowances and a set number of seats. Enterprise quoted annually with volume commitments, SSO and SLA. Human translation through the marketplace is priced per word by the linguist, with Smartcat taking a platform margin. Verify - Smartcat repackages tiers regularly.

Free plan

Yes - a free tier with a limited monthly word allowance, useful for evaluation.

Free trial

Yes - free trials of Business tiers, typically 14 days, plus guided pilots via sales.

Usage limits to consider

Word-volume allowances per plan with overage pricing; seat counts per tier; some connectors and AI features restricted to higher tiers.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The combination of MT, TM, human marketplace and automated contractor payment in one place removes a huge amount of vendor-management overhead
  • paying 500+ freelancers across jurisdictions is a solved problem here
  • very broad language coverage
  • strong CMS connectors for continuous localisation.

Limitations to consider

  • Complex product with a real learning curve
  • pricing is opaque and negotiated, making budgeting hard
  • marketplace linguist quality varies and needs vetting
  • overkill for small or occasional translation needs
  • word-overage charges can surprise.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • connectors and plugins for CMS and repositories
  • API

Languages

  • 280+ languages including Arabic and French; automatic MT engine selection per pair

API access

Yes - full REST API plus CLI for CI/CD localisation pipelines

Integrations and exports

  • WordPress, Drupal, Contentful, HubSpot, Figma, Adobe InDesign, GitHub, GitLab, Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, Zendesk, Marketo

Evaluation notes

The payment-automation feature is often the real reason enterprises buy Smartcat rather than the translation quality. Model your word volume carefully - overage is where the budget goes.
